versions.changelog:
Website Cloner 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides a step-by-step guide to fully clone any online website for local use, maintaining visual and interaction fidelity.
- Outlines detection of site type (SPA vs. traditional vs. hybrid) and details resource discovery to avoid missing dependencies.
- Includes practical CLI examples for file retrieval, directory setup, batch asset downloading, and adaptation for local environments.
- Emphasizes common pitfalls and checklists for CSS, fonts, JS data files, and image formats.
- Supplies troubleshooting tips, tool recommendations, and real-world usage scenarios for reliable offline website replication.
